empirical_response_origin.primary_procedure: GADM v3.6 island polygons intersected with IUCN 2017 mammal range polygons, manually checked/corrected by authors
empirical_response_origin.island_inclusion: only islands assigned >=1 mammal; ambiguous island-to-species attributions excluded
empirical_response_origin.important_mixed_time_semantics: historically native mammals extinct due to human activity were added from other references; not all positive cells therefore guarantee current extant source populations
empirical_response_origin.native_extirpated_label_count: unknown from frozen public matrix and currently unseparated
empirical_response_origin.known_original_validation: original study reported correlation 0.95±0.05 between mammal richness summaries from IUCN-derived maps and regional published compilations; not proof of per-species per-island cell correctness

structural_model_provenance.graph_source: regionally minimum-connected symmetrized kNN; 73,162 graph edges on 5,401 islands
structural_model_provenance.ultrarare_counts_interpretation: 1-4 positive pilot cells in the mapped/augmented source matrix, not 1-4 verified extant populations

claim_adjudication.retain: prospective within-matrix prediction of mapped positive cells, original geography-derived graph versus its 20 matched rewired surrogates, with unchanged effect estimates
claim_adjudication.replace: realized presence -> range-map-derived positive cell or mapped positive; true absence -> range-map-derived zero label
disallow: real-time current extant occupied source populations for all cells
biological adjacency uniquely recovered from IUCN range intersections
claim_adjudication.topical_risk: the geography of predictor and mapped outcome share spatial construction dependencies; graph-kNN advantage may reflect spatial polygon coherence rather than ecological movement
claim_adjudication.evidence_class: within-one-map-derived-label-source prospective species-layer predictive support; source ecology unvalidated
claim_adjudication.author_status_note: source authors manually corrected questionable polygons and independently cross-checked richness, so this is not a blanket assertion that the matrix is wrong
claim_adjudication.submission_recommendation: hold strong ecological-mechanism submission claims pending independent island-by-species occurrence validation

independent_checklist_candidate.source: Hébert et al. (2021), Journal of Biogeography DOI 10.1111/jbi.14156
independent_checklist_candidate.records: published literature/archipelago checklists/atlases, with some IUCN reference use in individual archipelagos
independent_checklist_candidate.independence: partially independent compilation; species-specific provenance must be checked and cannot be presumed fully independent
independent_checklist_candidate.next_gate: response-opaque island and species identity match to frozen 529x4126 prediction surface; no scores before identity thresholds and provenance review
